analysis.readme: Earlier source-specific R3 candidates remain in r7-final,r7-repair and r7-fullcollection. Final R3 distributions use only r7-membership five fixed pairs. Final ROW full-matrix reuse requires exact unchanged archive/observer SHA verified in the final freeze. Complete capped control distributions are combined without dropping any observations. Descriptive variation envelope uses maximum before process median and P95. The earlier max-after/min-before positive screen was conservative, not the registered stable-regression rejection. Uncertain cases remain unresolved. All original baseline and two extra complete control rounds retained; no failed-current observations reused. Import P95 with one sample/process is descriptive only.

original_gates.primary_p50: at least10% improvement,repeatable across independent processes
original_gates.protection: no stable P50/P95 regression>5% beyond before process variation;uncertain is not a pass
original_gates.strict_repeatability: primary:maximum after process median<=0.90*minimum before process median;protection reject when minimum after process median>1.05*maximum before process median;also report pooled/P95 distributions
original_gates.near_threshold: at most two additional predeclared independent processes for an uncertain affected case, all sources; never select only passing rounds
original_gates.resources: report process peak RSS and OS read/write blocks including setup/observation;file/live allocated bytes distinguished;>5%growth requires explicit reason/admission
original_gates.failure: preserve raw errors/partial samples;no latency success inferred;do not repeat deterministic same-source resource/unsupported failure in later rounds
original_gates.repair: only an attributable implementation defect/protection regression may reopen the affected source slice;required module checks,new freeze,and one affected-slice remeasurement with old failed evidence retained;no unrelated redesign

decision: Original registered stable-rejection formula applied after the complete fixed process/control budget:zero final stable rejections. Global repeatable10%primary gains come from explicit transaction filters/grouping,not from claiming every R3latency gains10%. R3live allocation saves20%. Preserve post-hoc maximum-envelope uncertainty as diagnostic and all pooled tails;it is not a newly registered universal max-after/min-before requirement. No claim of statistically equal tails or that every pooled metric is below5%. No failed layout was counted as production;earlier candidate outcomes remain separate.
source_review: >=48complete owners prove every column eligible after all existing identity/token/live/unused-bit checks;otherwise exact per-column validation remains. Reuse only the same pinned authenticated descriptor/pool reader. No wire/cache/permission/resource-cap change. All three modified source/test files match immutable source archive SHA under the recorded parent commit.

r3_space.notes: These are the same hashed R3inputs. Live allocation is not file length. Existing old-pin peak/file caps retained.
